## North Carolina November 3, 2026 Election Results

Download precinct-level results from the [North Carolina State Board of Elections](https://www.ncsbe.gov/results-data/election-results/historical-election-results-data):

- [Precinct-level results (tab-delimited TXT)](data/results_pct_20261103.txt)
- [Original results archive (ZIP)](data/results_pct_20261103.zip)

## NC House District Results

This map colors each district by the party of its leading candidate. Candidate votes are summed across precincts; in a race with only one listed candidate, that candidate is shown. District boundaries are from the [2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line state legislative district files](https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2024/SLDL/tl_2024_37_sldl.zip).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

results <- read_tsv("data/results_pct_20261103.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)

house_winners <- results |>
  filter(str_detect(`Contest Name`, "^NC HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES DISTRICT")) |>
  mutate(district = as.integer(str_extract(`Contest Name`, "\\d+$"))) |>
  group_by(district, Choice, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarise(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(district, desc(votes)) |>
  group_by(district) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(winner_party = case_when(
    `Choice Party` == "DEM" ~ "Democratic",
    `Choice Party` == "REP" ~ "Republican",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

house_districts <- st_read(
  "data/house_districts/tl_2024_37_sldl.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
) |>
  mutate(district = as.integer(SLDLST)) |>
  left_join(house_winners, by = "district") |>
  st_transform("EPSG:5070")

district_labels <- st_point_on_surface(house_districts)

ggplot(house_districts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = winner_party), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = district_labels,
    aes(label = district),
    size = 1.5,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      Democratic = "#3B82F6",
      Republican = "#EF4444",
      Other = "#8B5CF6"
    ),
    name = "Leading candidate's party"
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Leading candidate in each North Carolina House district",
    subtitle = "2026 NC House of Representatives races",
    caption = "Source: NC State Board of Elections; district boundaries: 2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
